svg.title: Ship engineer — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as ship engineer, wearing coveralls. Visible work cue: A wide marine-engine piston with a ring groove narrows into a connecting rod and round crank bearing. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a shaved head, a rounded face.
